notes.title: Duckles: the Jigsaw Witch Update Build 6.3 Performace enhancements
notes.notes:
We're glad to announce that Duckles: the Jigsaw Witch has been updated!

Build v 6.3 Update

* Updates include speed performance optimisation

* Quicker startup time

* Removed Splash/Loader Screen (no need for loading anymore)

* reduced weird  multiple flickers on startup

* Scalable Window (adjust according to your needs)

* Always 16:9  aspect ratio (unless you adjust it via window or choose old school 16-bit res, etc)

* supports resolution for both old and new school gamers

We apologise for taking so long for this update. A lot had/has been happening during 2017's pipeline and had to priorities to prevent a botching jobs. So we hope this improves your experience with the game significantly.

Note: It's running beautifully on an i5 6GB latop and perfomance has dramatically increased on overall devices. 
So for true gamer machines, this should be a breeze! Let us know if there's anything else needed.

Thanks, guys!

notes.title: Updates & DLC
notes.notes:
UPDATES - NOTES TO GAMERS.

Duckles: the Jigsaw Witch now supports higher resolutions and joypad config settings. 
We plan to update and improve quality again soon to help optimize the gaming experience as much as possible. Having said that, we have made sure that the game runs very well, plays well and is easy to start  and get to playing. The human interface for the gameplay is pretty simple and should allow gamers to do just that.


DLC

Developement for Dukles: the Jigsaw Witch 1st content will be on works this month January 2017. This shoud expand the overall story and lore of Witch Island. Stay tuned to find out  more soon!

Thanks!
